definition: A **trade union** is an association of workers or employers formed mainly to regulate relations between members and employers (or among workers/employers), including imposing lawful restrictive conditions on trade or business conduct. **Registration** under the Industrial Relations Code gives legal personality, rights to represent in disputes, and access to **statutory immunities** when acting in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
